note: 3-touch sequence. {signal} MUST be a real, specific observation about THIS prospect — the human editor verifies it before sending. Keep touch 1 under 80 words (the compliance footer is excluded from the count).

touches.subject: {signal} — a 40% shortcut?
touches.body:
Hi {first_name},

{signal} — that usually means tier-1 tickets are eating your team's day.

I built {product} to {outcome}. It just went live. Worth a 15-minute look, or should I send a 90-second demo instead?

Either way, no pressure.

touches.subject: one number from a team like {company}
touches.body:
Hi {first_name},

Quick follow-up with something useful either way: one {role}-led team cut first-response time from 14h to 1.1h in nine weeks after routing tier-1 through {product}.

Happy to share exactly how they did it, whether or not you ever try the tool. Want the teardown?

touches.subject: closing the loop, {first_name}
touches.body:
Hi {first_name},

I'll stop here so I'm not cluttering your inbox. If tier-1 ticket volume ever becomes the thing you want to fix, {product} will be here.

Thanks for reading this far.
